title: Inner Child Guide, 27 November: two pointers to the somatic guide's new sections

items.title: Re-do Trauma Memories: a pointer to Imagery Rescripting
items.my_version: If a memory feels too big to redo on your own, there's an actual clinical therapy for that, called [Imagery Rescripting](https://ibogaqueen.substack.com/i/201523223/imagery-rescripting), which I only found out about after I wrote this section. The therapist steps into the memory as the ideal adult, protecting and nurturing your inner child, until you learn to do that yourself.

items.title: Physical Pain?: a pointer to the two pain therapies, six tries, its second sentence Medium
items.your_version: If the tests keep coming back normal while that investigation goes on, I'd also try one of the two talk therapies I go into in my somatic guide, Pain Reprocessing Therapy or Emotional Awareness and Expression Therapy. They've helped people with long-lasting back, muscle and joint pain, by changing their relationship to the pain without pretending it's not there.
